import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { city } from "./city";

export const country = defineTable("country", {
    columns: {
        countryId: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        country: col.text().notNull(),
        lastUpdate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().onCreateNow()
    },
    relations: {
        city: rel.hasMany(() => city)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
